# Browser forecast inputs

- The v2 npm lockfile comes from npm CLI's [Arborist rebuild fixture](https://github.com/npm/cli/blob/8f92e740ee1547568779284005454ce2f1a5e58b/workspaces/arborist/test/fixtures/rebuild-foreground-scripts/package-lock.json) (Artistic-2.0). Tests read only the JSON.
- The Python files come from Requests' [documentation requirements](https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/3c7baaa05ab4aa49cc819ce3a819d260de19c157/docs/requirements.txt) and [project configuration](https://github.com/psf/requests/blob/3c7baaa05ab4aa49cc819ce3a819d260de19c157/pyproject.toml) (Apache-2.0).
